Callout.Name: Kidnapping in Progress
Callout.Message: Person forced into a vehicle, caller following at a distance.
Callout.Advisory: Two suspects, victim in the back seat, vehicle still moving.

Script.Line: They put him in the back of a blue van and drove off.
I am following it. Two cars back, that is all.
It has turned towards the docks. It is going towards the docks.

Lines.Approach: They put somebody in the back of it and drove. The caller is behind them and staying on the line.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
